anti_overlap: Nav wording, the Kinds and Traits consolidations, findability and reachability of sections, header-search behaviour, front-door composition, and back-links or missing indexes — owned by the market-inspection reviewer.
Whether a stranger can predict a destination from a label; route-level navigation questions belong to the other lens except where a label makes a provenance claim.
Layout aesthetics, colour palette, typography and responsive behaviour judged for their own sake, plus performance and accessibility audits.
Any proposal that changes data, vocabulary, the census registry, or the export contract — out of scope for this review entirely.
decision_lens: Ask of every sentence on the page: at reading speed, does this look like something the site read or something the site wrote — and is that impression correct? Where it is not, prefer the least intrusive marking that makes it correct at close range without breaking the reading at normal distance, and require that whatever marking is chosen be the same one on every page and hold when the sentence travels alone in a share card or a search result. For each shippable variant, state the belief a reader forms under it and the belief they would form under the alternatives, and recommend the one whose reader-belief is both correct and reachable without extra clicks. Rank by how much a wrong impression would cost in the first five minutes, treating an unmarked fill in the most-read position as worse than a heavily-marked one in an obscure one.
distance_rationale: Conservation is a centuries-old craft with a codified, contested, empirically-tested answer to exactly the question this preview is asking: when most of a surface is modern fill, how must the fill be marked so that a viewer at normal viewing distance reads a coherent whole while a viewer at close range can always tell restoration from original — and what a treatment report must say for the marking to mean anything. Its practitioners argue in terms of lacunae, integration distance, distinguishability, and reversibility rather than trust, transparency, or disclosure, so the lens cannot restate the artifact's own framing back to it. It shares no parent discipline with market regulation (the other lens here) and none with any AI-cliche domain: it is material practice on objects, not biology, information theory, or evolutionary reasoning.
expected_isomorphisms: original fabric versus modern fill ↔ census attestation versus machine-written prose: 4,541 of 5,057 evidence strings are fill, and the whole treatment question is how that fill is dressed
tratteggio — visible as hatching at close range, integrated at viewing distance ↔ the gloss styling: no quote marks, no rule, no italics, yet still legibly the site's own hand rather than a quotation
a lacuna left neutral rather than inpainted ↔ the 92 figures with no 'Recorded in' row, where absence is rendered as plain absence and cannot be told from 'not checked'
uniform varnish over unlike surfaces ↔ a single .gloss class carrying trait evidence, kinship evidence and symbol evidence, so the site's most careful claim and its weakest wear the same dress
the treatment report that travels with the object ↔ the About page: whether it names every element a viewer will meet, and whether it survives being read alone by someone who never sees the object
reversibility — a fill must be removable without loss ↔ the variant switcher and the question of which variant ships: the ruled variant becomes the page and the machinery goes

'the restoration must not be a historical or artistic fake' ↔ share metadata: an unmarked machine-written sentence travelling off-site as og:description, and a preview build emitting canonical and og:url for production addresses

the condition report's discipline that every observation carry its method ↔ the inconsistency between class/[slug].astro, which shows an evidence sentence only when provenance.method is 'llm-proposed', and the creature page, which shows it always
focus: Whether a reader moving at reading speed can tell, at every point on a page, which sentences are the site's own writing and which rest on something read — and whether the marking rule is the same one everywhere, holds up on the page's absences, survives being carried off-site in a share card, and is explained by a document that can be read alone.
name: fd-tratteggio-fill-legibility
persona: Apply the perspective of a paintings conservator judging a reintegration — a practitioner who accepts that most of this surface is fill and that the fill is legitimate, and whose entire professional question is whether the fill is distinguishable from original fabric at close range while still reading as one picture from where a viewer actually stands. This reviewer refuses the two easy failures equally: an imitative inpainting that lets fill pass as original, and a treatment so loudly marked that nobody can see the picture. It insists the same convention be used across the whole surface and across every object in the collection, treats an unfilled lacuna as a statement that must itself be legible, and holds that the treatment report is part of the object — an object that travels without it has been misrepresented. It reasons in lacunae, fills, hatching, viewing distance, integration, distinguishability, reversibility, and the report.
review_areas: Fill inventory at reading distance — walk every string a creature page renders (name, aliases, lede, each facts value, the Recorded-in titles, trait glosses, kinship glosses, symbol definitions and evidence, description paragraphs, the extrapolation note, axis readings) and say for each what a reader at reading speed takes it to be versus what it is; give particular weight to the lede, which About calls machine-written but the page marks in no way, while the Description below it is explicitly labelled.

One convention or several — whether the marking rule is the same across the site: the .gloss class carries trait, kinship and symbol evidence identically though About describes kinship as drawn only where a source states descent; class/[slug].astro renders the sentence only when provenance.method is 'llm-proposed' while the creature page always renders it; and the preview's data-gloss='hidden' switch, labelled 'Trait sentences', also removes kinship and symbol sentences.

Lacunae — how the page renders what it does not have: the Recorded-in row is simply absent for the 92 unmatched figures, so a reader cannot distinguish 'no volume we read names this figure' from 'not looked up'; and the row, when present, sits inside the same dl as Tradition, Region, Kind and Family with no adjacent sentence and no link out, where it can read as the source of the page rather than as a list of works that mention the name.

The variants as degrees of reintegration — for Description present / absent / disclosure, gloss shown / hidden, and profile collapsed / open / absent, state the reader-belief and the comprehension cost of each (with Description absent, the prose the glosses were read from is nowhere on the page, so the gloss's own origin becomes unverifiable in place), recommend one to ship, and check the rendered order against the order the design record claims, since the profile currently precedes the Description in the DOM.

The treatment report — whether About's element list actually covers everything a reader meets (aliases, symbols, the extrapolation marker, axis wording, the lede in its own right), whether each definition survives being read alone by someone who arrived at About first, and what happens to a reader who follows its census link into a page written in the pipeline's language ('canon', 'candidate', 'registered', 'still in the queue', 'the corpus').

Claims that travel — og:title, og:description (the unmarked machine lede), a single constellation og:image for every page, and canonical/og:url emitted against site: https://jawnomicon.com even from the preview build; plus the copy that carries the honesty claim itself, checked for pipeline vocabulary, hedging, over-explaining subheads, and generated-text tics such as instructional captions or one-word links standing in for a sentence.
severity_examples: P0: The lede is the creature page's first sentence, its og:description, and its search-result snippet, and About states plainly that it is machine-written — yet nothing on the creature page marks it, while the Description further down is explicitly labelled 'Machine-written'. The asymmetry teaches the reader that unmarked text is sourced, which inverts the honesty model exactly where it is read most and where it travels off-site unaccompanied by any report.

P1: A single .gloss class dresses trait evidence (90% machine prose), kinship evidence (which About says is drawn only where a source states descent) and symbol evidence identically, and the preview's 'Trait sentences: hidden' control removes all three — so the site's most careful claim and its weakest are indistinguishable, and the variant being ruled on is not the variant the label describes.

P2: astro.config sets site to https://jawnomicon.com, so every preview page emits a canonical link and og:url pointing at the production address; a preview link shared for review unfurls as though it were the live page, and every page in the site shares one constellation image regardless of subject.
source_domain: Pictorial reintegration in art conservation — Cesare Brandi's Teoria del restauro and the tratteggio/rigatino hatched fill developed at the Istituto Centrale per il Restauro, together with chromatic abstraction, neutral fills, the Venice Charter's requirement that additions be distinguishable and bear the mark of their own time, the doctrine of reversibility, and the condition and treatment reports that travel with a treated object.
success_hints: Read the page the way a reader does — straight through, at speed — and report the belief formed at each point before checking what the template actually does; the gap between those two is the finding.

Name the exact marking you would use and where it goes, at the smallest scale that works: a half-sentence in place beats a badge, a badge beats a panel, a panel beats a new page. Say what it costs in reading flow.
Recommend one shippable variant per control, and state for each rejected option the specific belief a reader would form under it — not a general 'less trust' claim.
Check every honesty claim the copy makes against what the template renders, and treat a true claim in a place nobody reads as an unmet claim.
Keep to templates and copy: no data, vocabulary, or export edits, and no proposal that depends on new provenance fields existing.
